terms.name: genome subcompartments
terms.definition: Fine-grained chromatin compartments (A1, A2, B1, B2, B3, B4) within major A/B compartments.

terms.name: perturbation signal
terms.definition: Phenotypic signal associated with CRISPR perturbations.

terms.name: DNN-MPRA contribution scores
terms.definition: Nucleotide contribution scores from a deep neural network trained on MPRA data.

terms.name: selected regions for bias-corrected predicted signal profile
terms.definition: Genomic regions selected for bias-corrected signal profile interpretation.

terms.name: selected regions for predicted bias profile
terms.definition: Genomic regions selected for predicted bias profile interpretation.

terms.name: selected regions for predicted signal and sequence contribution scores
terms.definition: Genomic regions selected for combined signal and contribution score analysis.

terms.name: selected regions for profile sequence contribution scores
terms.definition: Genomic regions selected for profile contribution score analysis.

terms.name: training and test regions
terms.definition: Genomic regions designated for model training and held-out evaluation.

terms.name: element gene interactions signal
terms.definition: Signal strength of element-gene interaction associations.

terms.name: IDR ranked peaks
terms.definition: Peaks ranked by IDR score, with lower IDR indicating higher reproducibility across replicates.

terms.name: genic features quantifications
terms.definition: Quantifications across various genic features (exons, introns, UTRs).

terms.name: phastcons score reference
terms.definition: Reference phastCons conservation scores across the genome.

terms.name: cell topic participation
terms.definition: Cell-level participation scores in latent topics from topic modeling.

terms.name: exclusion list regions
terms.definition: Genomic blacklist regions excluded due to mapping artifacts or technical issues.

terms.name: nanopore signal
terms.definition: Raw ionic current signal from nanopore sequencing.

terms.name: negative control regions
terms.definition: Genomic regions used as negative controls in experiments.

terms.name: positive control regions
terms.definition: Genomic regions used as positive controls in experiments.
